description: Automatic Traffic Counters Data is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of York Council. Please note that this dataset is no longer getting updated This dataset contains count data aggregated by hour for each of the automatic traffic counters (ATC) upgraded as part of City of York Council's STEP project. Coverage: City of York Council. The portal files it under the publisher City of York Council. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-09-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
